Want to be your son's best friend for life? 📻 Start now.

At six, Owen grabs his walkie-talkie: "Mom, come in!" At sixteen, it's: "Mom? You there?" Whether he still calls depends on whether the channel stayed open.

Ways to keep it open:
✅ Listen first. Give attention, not a lecture.
✅ The little things are big ones to him. 🐛
✅ Never laugh at what he shares. He's growing into a man.
✅ Phone down. Full attention when he tells you something. 📱
✅ Mistakes are okay. Correct the behavior, not the boy.
✅ Ask about his world, even when you don't understand it. 🎮
✅ Say sorry when you get it wrong.
✅ Make home a safe place. 🏠
✅ Love with no conditions. Lost 0-3? Still "my son." ⚽

Owen is sixteen. One night, the old walkie crackles: "Mom… I messed up." And because the channel stayed open, he called you first. ❤️

Jesus called us friends. "Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends." John 15:13 (ESV) 🙏 He laid down His life so we'd always be within His reach.

Build it now, so he still calls when he's older. ❤️ And if your little one goes quiet, sometimes that's worry, not distance.
